description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for streaming batch tests in Orleans, including methods for testing batch sending and consumption, utilizing Orleans streaming and testing utilities.

classes.name: StreamBatchingTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing streaming batch test methods for Orleans, including batch send/consume scenarios and report checking.

methods.name: SingleSendBatchConsume
methods.description: Tests sending a batch of messages individually and consuming them, verifying the total count.

methods.name: BatchSendSingleConsume
methods.description: Tests sending multiple batches and consuming them as a single batch, verifying total count.

methods.name: BatchSendBatchConsume
methods.description: Tests sending multiple batches and consuming them in batch, verifying total count and batch size.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Checks the consumption report against expected values, asserting correctness.
